# The manifest: `est.json`

The manifest of an EST plugin bundle (EST specification §1), as Cyber's install reader (parseManifest) accepts it; a test proves the two agree. `est pack` fills module.sha256, module.bytes, ui.sha256 and assets from the files, so a plugin's source est.json may leave those out. Unknown keys are ignored. Lengths are in characters (the host counts UTF-16 code units: a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane counts twice there).

Every bundle has an `est.json` at its root. Name the schema in it (`"$schema"`) and an editor completes and checks the fields as you type; `est validate` checks the same rules (Cyber's reader, `parseManifest`), so a manifest the schema accepts is one Cyber installs. `est pack` fills in the hashes and sizes (`module.sha256`, `module.bytes`, `ui.sha256`, `assets`, marked *filled by `est pack`* below): leave them out of your source `est.json`. They are required in a bundle, so an editor checking a source `est.json` against the schema reports them missing; that is expected.

Schema: `est-manifest-1.schema.json` (beside `est.json` in every folder `est new` makes), JSON Schema 2020-12.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | string |  | Where the schema is, for an editor (`./est-manifest-1.schema.json` in a folder `est new` made). `est pack` leaves it out of the bundle. |
| `est` | `1` | yes | The manifest schema version: 1. |
| `id` | string | yes | The plugin's id, a reverse-DNS name (`com.example.my-verb`), the same as its CLAP descriptor's. Never changed: projects name the plugin by it. (EST-M002) Matches `^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]{1,118})[a-z0-9]$`. |
| `version` | string | yes | A semantic version. (EST-M003) Matches `^\d{1,6}\.\d{1,6}\.\d{1,6}(?:[-+][0-9A-Za-z.-]{1,40})?$`. |
| `name` | string | yes | The plugin's name as Cyber shows it. (EST-M004) Matches `^(?=[\s\S]*\S)[^\u0000-\u001f\u007f]*$`; 0 to 60 characters. |
| `vendor` | string | yes | Who makes it. (EST-M004) Matches `^(?=[\s\S]*\S)[^\u0000-\u001f\u007f]*$`; 0 to 60 characters. |
| `description` | string |  | One or two plain sentences. (EST-M004) Matches `^[^\u0000-\u001f\u007f]*$`; 0 to 400 characters. |
| `url` | string |  | The plugin's web page, https only. (EST-M004) Matches `^https://[^\s]{1,300}$`. |
| `license` | string | yes | An SPDX licence id or name (`MIT`). (EST-M004) Matches `^(?=[\s\S]*\S)[^\u0000-\u001f\u007f]*$`; 0 to 64 characters. |
| `kind` | `"effect"` or `"instrument"` | yes | An effect (audio in, audio out) or an instrument (notes in, audio out). (EST-M005) |
| `features` | list of string | yes | CLAP feature names, the kind's first: `audio-effect` or `instrument`. (EST-M006) 1 to 32 items. |
| `abi` | object | yes | (EST-M007) |
| `abi.est` | `"1.0"` or `"1.1"` | yes | The EST ABI edition: `1.0`, or (since Cyber 1.327) `1.1` for the fields EST 1.1 adds (a sidechain, up to 8 channels, `modulatable`, `ui.audio`, a preset's `image` and `author`). A newer edition is refused (EST-M019); a 1.1 field in a 1.0 manifest is refused (EST-M020). |
| `abi.clap` | string | yes | The CLAP version (`1.2`). Matches `^1\.\d{1,4}(\.\d{1,4})?$`; 0 to 16 characters. |
| `module` | object | yes | The WebAssembly module. (EST-M008) |
| `module.path` | string | yes | The module's path in the bundle (`module.wasm`). Matches `^(?!(?:[^/]*/)*\.\.?(?:/\|$))[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)*$`; 1 to 255 characters. |
| `module.sha256` | string | filled by `est pack` | Filled by `est pack`. Matches `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`. |
| `module.bytes` | integer | filled by `est pack` | Filled by `est pack`. 8 to 67108864. |
| `ui` | null or object |  | A custom UI page, or null (or absent) for the generated UI. (EST-M009) |
| `ui.path` | string | yes | A path in the bundle: `/`-separated segments of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, none `.` or `..`. (EST-B005) Matches `^(?!(?:[^/]*/)*\.\.?(?:/\|$))[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)*$`; 1 to 255 characters. |
| `ui.sha256` | string | filled by `est pack` | Filled by `est pack`. Matches `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`. |
| `ui.size` | object | yes |  |
| `ui.size.w` | integer | yes | 120 to 2000. |
| `ui.size.h` | integer | yes | 80 to 1400. |
| `ui.resizable` |  |  | Read but unused in EST 1.0 (frame protocol 1 has no resize message): the host draws the frame at `size`, never scaled. |
| `ui.audio` | boolean |  | EST 1.1 (frame protocol v3): the page may ask for an analysis of the plugin's output (`est.audio()`: magnitudes and RMS at most 30 times a second, never samples). (EST-M020) Default `false`. |
| `assets` | list of objects | filled by `est pack` | Every other file in the bundle, hashed. Written by `est pack`. (EST-M010) |
| `assets[].path` | string | yes | A path in the bundle: `/`-separated segments of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, none `.` or `..`. (EST-B005) Matches `^(?!(?:[^/]*/)*\.\.?(?:/\|$))[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)*$`; 1 to 255 characters. |
| `assets[].sha256` | string | yes | Matches `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`. |
| `audio` | object | yes | One main audio port each way at most; EST 1.1: an effect's inputs may add a sidechain after it. (EST-M011, EST-M021) |
| `audio.inputs` | list of objects | yes | 0 to 2 items. |
| `audio.inputs[].channels` | integer | yes | 1 or 2 in EST 1.0; up to 8 on a main port in EST 1.1 (an instrument's further pairs play on output strips; an effect's past two are summed into its stereo strip); a sidechain has 1 or 2. 1 to 8. |
| `audio.inputs[].role` | `"main"` or `"sidechain"` |  | EST 1.1: the first port is the main one; an effect's second input is the `"sidechain"`, fed from a track or a return. (EST-M021) |
| `audio.outputs` | list of objects | yes | 0 to 1 items. |
| `audio.outputs[].channels` | integer | yes | 1 or 2 in EST 1.0; up to 8 on a main port in EST 1.1 (an instrument's further pairs play on output strips; an effect's past two are summed into its stereo strip); a sidechain has 1 or 2. 1 to 8. |
| `audio.outputs[].role` | `"main"` or `"sidechain"` |  | EST 1.1: the first port is the main one; an effect's second input is the `"sidechain"`, fed from a track or a return. (EST-M021) |
| `audio.sampleRates` |  |  | Informational in EST 1.0: the host does not read it. The templates write "any": a plugin runs at the audio context's rate (44.1 or 48 kHz, whatever the device runs at) and must take whatever `activate` gives it. |
| `notes` | object |  | Note ports: 0 or 1 each way; an instrument has a note input. (A value that is not an object is read as none.) (EST-M012) |
| `notes.inputs` | integer |  | 0 to 1. |
| `notes.outputs` | integer |  | 0 to 1. |
| `limits` | object |  | The most the plugin may use; the host holds it to them. (A value that is not an object is read as the defaults.) (EST-M013) |
| `limits.maxLatencyFrames` | integer |  | 0 to 192000; default `0`. |
| `limits.memoryPagesMax` | integer |  | 64 KiB pages; the module's declared maximum must be within it. 1 to 2048; default `256`. |
| `limits.tailSeconds` | integer |  | 0 to 60; default `0`. |
| `permissions` | array |  | EST 1.0 grants none: empty. (EST-M014) Empty. |
| `parameters` | list of objects |  | A mirror of the module's parameters: the same ids. (EST-M015) 0 to 512 items. |
| `parameters[].id` | integer | yes | 0 to 4294967295. |
| `parameters[].name` | string | yes | Matches `^(?=[\s\S]*\S)[^\u0000-\u001f\u007f]*$`; 0 to 255 characters. |
| `parameters[].unit` | string |  | Matches `^[^\u0000-\u001f\u007f]*$`; 0 to 16 characters. |
| `parameters[].scale` | `"linear"` or `"log"` |  | How knobs, sliders and automation move over the parameter's range: "log" geometrically (a lane's midpoint is the geometric middle; the range the module reports must stay above 0, EST-C021). Since EST 1.286. Default `"linear"`. |
| `parameters[].modulatable` | boolean |  | EST 1.1: Cyber's clip envelopes may send this parameter `CLAP_EVENT_PARAM_MOD`; the DSP flags it `CLAP_PARAM_IS_MODULATABLE` (EST-C022). (EST-M020) Default `false`. |
| `stateVersion` | integer |  | The version of the state the plugin saves. (EST-M016) 1 to 1000000; default `1`. |
| `presets` | null or string |  | The bundle's preset index (`presets/index.json`), or null. (EST-M017) |
| `compat` |  |  | Informational in EST 1.0: Cyber's reader ignores it. The host versions the bundle is built for (the specification draft's plan: a bundle outside the range installs with a warning and runs). |
| `compat.host` |  |  | A semver range of EST host versions; the templates write ">=1.0.0 <2". |
| `migrate` | list of objects |  | Since Cyber 1.337: what this version does with the settings a project saved with an earlier version. On Use installed version, Cyber applies the first entry whose `from` takes the version moved from and says what it kept, moved and dropped; without one, settings cross by id as before. A manifest with `migrate` lists its `parameters`. (EST-M022) 0 to 32 items. |
| `migrate[].from` | string | yes | The versions this entry applies to: comparators separated by spaces, all of which must hold (`>=1.0.0 <1.2.0`), a single version (that one only), or `*` (every version). Versions compare as semver (a pre-release before its release). Matches `^\s*(?:\*\|(?:>=\|<=\|>\|<\|=)?\d{1,6}\.\d{1,6}\.\d{1,6}(?:[-+][0-9A-Za-z.-]{1,40})?)(?:\s+(?:\*\|(?:>=\|<=\|>\|<\|=)?\d{1,6}\.\d{1,6}\.\d{1,6}(?:[-+][0-9A-Za-z.-]{1,40})?))*\s*$`; 1 to 100 characters. |
| `migrate[].params` | object |  | Old CLAP id (a decimal string) to new id (a renamed or split parameter: the value moves) or `null` (dropped on purpose). Every new id must be one `parameters` lists; an old id named by neither this map nor `parameters` is dropped with a note. |
| `migrate[].state` | `"keep"` or `"drop"` |  | Whether the saved state (the CLAP state stream) crosses: `keep` (the plugin reads its earlier versions' state, CLAP's rule) or `drop` (the new version starts from its defaults on purpose, with the mapped values on top). Default `"keep"`. |

By kind (the schema's conditional rules):

- When `kind` is `"effect"`: `features[0]` is `"audio-effect"`; `audio.inputs` has at least 1 item; `audio.outputs` has at least 1 item.
- When `kind` is `"instrument"`: `notes` is required; `features[0]` is `"instrument"`; `notes.inputs` is required; `notes.inputs` is `1`.

An example, EST Gain's (the reference effect, before packing):

```json
{
  "est": 1,
  "id": "org.cyber.est-gain",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "name": "EST Gain",
  "vendor": "Cyber",
  "description": "A smoothed gain in dB: Cyber's reference EST effect.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "kind": "effect",
  "features": ["audio-effect", "utility", "stereo"],
  "abi": { "est": "1.0", "clap": "1.2" },
  "module": { "path": "module.wasm" },
  "audio": { "inputs": [{ "channels": 2 }], "outputs": [{ "channels": 2 }], "sampleRates": "any" },
  "notes": { "inputs": 0, "outputs": 0 },
  "limits": { "maxLatencyFrames": 0, "memoryPagesMax": 16, "tailSeconds": 0 },
  "parameters": [{ "id": 0, "name": "Gain", "unit": "dB" }],
  "stateVersion": 1,
  "permissions": [],
  "compat": { "host": ">=1.0.0 <2" }
}
```
